research_findings: Discovered an accessibility warning in the browser console caused by Radix UI's DialogContent missing an aria-describedby attribute when no DialogDescription is present in FeedbackModal.
Identified that the Fuse.js fuzzy searching in ProblemExplorer was executing on every keystroke in the main thread, potentially causing frame drops during rapid typing on large lists.
features_improved: Optimized ProblemExplorer's client-side problem filtering by deferring the search string with useDeferredValue, improving perceived typing responsiveness.
Fixed an accessibility violation and console warning in FeedbackModal by explicitly defining aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent.
next_steps_for_next_run: Evaluate server-side caching mechanisms (e.g. Next.js cache or Redis) for the problems catalog to further reduce Time to First Byte (TTFB).
Investigate upgrading to more recent Next.js 16/React 19 caching APIs for user progress data to minimize Prisma DB queries.
